description: What was done in this app, newest first, from Ploa's audit log: store details sent, builds and releases, approvals asked and decided, keys and settings changed, each with who did it (a person, an agent by name, a token, or Ploa itself) and when. Use it when picking up work another session or person started, or when the person asks who changed something.
